basic_profile.bio: A recent transplant to Texas, originally from the Midwest. I'm a big sports fan, particularly college football, which is what brought me to LonghornNation. I enjoy discussing game strategies and player stats. Besides sports, I'm interested in fantasy novels and technology. I work as a junior IT technician and am currently single, living in Austin. Usually online in the evenings after work, from around 6 PM to 11 PM.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise is primarily in IT support, having completed an associate degree in Information Technology. I have a self-taught background in fantasy literature, gained through years of reading and participating in online forums.
